meta.ruling: The engine is a generic, config-driven dotfiles tool at claude/tools/wiki/; the YieldPoint wiki holds only config and content.

engine.file: included from the dotfiles root Makefile after the artifact include; WIKI is required by every verb, empty is a usage error exit 2; includes mk/*.mk; target wiki-test runs tests/test_*.py in the pinned python image
stdlib only: utc_now, sha256_file, slug, read_frontmatter, write_frontmatter, load_config, atomic_write, secret_patterns

wiki-root.dir: one capture per source by content hash

config.key: command that prints a store path; tests set a fake

raw.frontmatter: source (~ for $HOME), captured_at (UTC Z), sha256, bytes, blob (artifact store path, only over the limit)

processed.frontmatter: id, title, topic, sources (raw file names), updated
processed.body: '# title'; '## Contents'; one '## Heading' per section of pages.json; every section links ../raw/ at least once

codes.code: blob sent to the artifact store
codes.note: FB-001 and FB-004 are fallback switch codes of timed-run.sh --fallback (WO-20261016-d304), not wiki codes.

verb.name: intake
verb.inputs: SRC: files or directories; a directory recurses over *.md, *.xml, *.json sorted; empty SRC exits 2
verb.outputs: raw/<sha12>-<slug(basename)>.md with frontmatter source, captured_at, sha256, bytes and the text; over blob_limit_bytes the bytes go to the path printed by artifact_new and the raw file holds frontmatter with blob: and no body
verb.codes: WIKI-001 captured; WIKI-002 already captured (prints the path, writes nothing); WIKI-003 blob sent to the artifact store
verb.idempotency: sha256 decides: a second run adds nothing; a changed source adds one file

fallback.use: bash ~/dotfiles/claude/tools/artifact/artifact.sh new, same KEY NAME EXT
fallback.test: fake artifact_new fails, the artifact.sh path is used

verb.name: process
verb.outputs: missing page: skeleton with each section body TODO-WRITE and one [raw: file](../raw/file) per source; present page: rewrite only frontmatter sources and updated, append missing sections, never touch section bodies
verb.codes: WIKI-010 skeleton written; WIKI-011 page unchanged; a source missing from raw exits 3 with WIKI-034 (see the design, Gaps)
verb.idempotency: a rerun is byte identical; written prose survives

fallback.use: rerun with --pull=never on the locally cached image of the same digest
fallback.test: pull refused, the cached digest runs

verb.name: index
verb.outputs: index/README.md: title, '## Contents', '## Pages' table (id link, title, section count), '## Topic map' (one '### topic', pages sorted by id), '## Backlinks' (per raw file sorted, citing pages)
verb.idempotency: deterministic bytes; a rerun leaves the file unchanged

fallback.use: rerun with --pull=never on the locally cached image of the same digest
fallback.test: pull refused, the cached digest runs

verb.name: review
verb.inputs: review.json; the newest raw capture whose source equals raw_source; artifact-find output for assets
verb.outputs: review_dir/<page>/design.md (the capture body) and index.html from review.html.tmpl (marked@12.0.2, footer 'generated by make wiki-review from raw/file sha256 sha12'); asset files copied from the store; files under review_dir/<page>/ the script did not write are tarred to the path printed by artifact-new KEY=backup, then removed, never deleted without the tar; atomic writes
verb.codes: WIKI-040 review page written, one per page
verb.idempotency: a rerun is byte identical; a hand file is tarred once, then gone

fallback.use: bash ~/dotfiles/claude/tools/artifact/artifact.sh new, same KEY NAME EXT
fallback.test: fake artifact_new fails, the artifact.sh path is used

fallback.use: rerun with --pull=never on the locally cached image of the same digest
fallback.test: pull refused, the cached digest runs

verb.name: check
verb.inputs: processed/*.md and index/README.md; raw/ for secrets and orphans
verb.codes: WIKI-031 first H2 is not Contents; WIKI-032 relative link target file or #anchor missing; WIKI-033 raw file cited by no page; WIKI-034 section without a ../raw/ link; WIKI-035 page over max_page_lines; WIKI-036 a line in raw/ or processed/ matching secret_patterns; WIKI-037 TODO-WRITE left; WIKI-030 check failed (summary); no finding prints WIKI-000
verb.idempotency: read-only; two runs print the same lines and exit the same

fallback.use: rerun with --pull=never on the locally cached image of the same digest
fallback.test: pull refused, the cached digest runs

fallback.use: none needed: a file on main read locally; a missing file stops with exit 4
none needed: files on main read locally; a missing file stops with exit 4
missing on the host: stop with ENV-MISSING; GitHub down: retry 3 times, then stop with A2A-003 and its output

gates.gate: podman sandbox, fixtures, fake artifact_new, only the tests the change touches
